# Purpose

This workflow identifies nucleosomes with large changes in occupancy, fuzziness,
and position. A cutoff is calculated from one reference sample and is then applied
to every supplied DANPOS3 result file.

Edit only the named `files` vector in the **Input files** section to analyse a new
set of files. The names of the vector become sample labels in the output filenames.

# Dependencies

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

library(tidyverse)
library(plyranges)
library(ggpubr)
```

# Functions

```{r functions}
# Read a DANPOS3 result table and standardise commonly used columns.
set.seed(1425)
read_nuc_file <- function(file) {
  nucs <- readr::read_tsv(
    file = file,
    na = c("", "NA", "NaN", "Inf", "-Inf"),
    trim_ws = TRUE,
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE
  )

  nucs <- nucs %>%
    mutate(
      start = suppressWarnings(as.integer(start)),
      end = suppressWarnings(as.integer(end))
    )
  nucs
}

# can be downloaded via GEO or found in the pipeline results.
nucs_i24 <- read_nuc_file("/data/di_mnaseq/Watzlowik_et_al_2023/nextmna/24hpi_results_v52/04_differential_nucleosome_positioning/results/adjustedFDR/24hpi_iKO-24hpi_noKO.positions.FDR_corrected.xls")

nucs_i0 <- read_nuc_file("/data/di_mnaseq/Watzlowik_et_al_2023/nextmna/0hpi_results_v52/04_differential_nucleosome_positioning/results/adjustedFDR/0hpi_iKO-0hpi_noKO.positions.FDR_corrected.xls")


# Find the first ranked position where the spline derivative exceeds the threshold.
# The default return value remains a numeric cutoff so existing code can continue to
# use occCutOff, fuzzCutOff, and shiftCutOff directly.
get_high_var_nucs <- function(ranked_dat,
                              slope_at_cutoff = 1,
                              plot_cutoff = TRUE,
                              return_details = FALSE, shift=FALSE) {
  
  if(shift){
    fitx <- smooth.spline(
      x = ranked_dat$fdr_rank,
      y = ranked_dat$norm_fdr,spar = 0.8
    )
  } else {
    fitx <- smooth.spline(
      x = ranked_dat$fdr_rank,
      y = ranked_dat$norm_fdr
    )
  }
  
  f1 <- predict(
    fitx,
    x = ranked_dat$fdr_rank,
    deriv = 1
  )
  
  # Find the cutoff position where the slope is > slope_at_cutoff
  slope_above_cutoff <- which(f1$y > slope_at_cutoff)
  
  # positions are only valid after the first 1000 lowest variances. 
  # This is necessary as sometimes the first ones have a quite high predicted slope. 
  valid_cutoff_positions <- slope_above_cutoff[slope_above_cutoff > 1000]
  cutOff <- min(valid_cutoff_positions) / nrow(ranked_dat)
  
  cutOff_FDR <- ranked_dat %>%
    filter(fdr_rank == cutOff) %>% 
    pull(fdr)
  
  
  plt <- ranked_dat %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = fdr_rank, y = norm_fdr)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 0.7) +
    geom_point(
      data = ranked_dat %>% filter(fdr_rank >= cutOff),
      color = "red",
      alpha = 0.65,
      size = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = cutOff, linetype = "dashed") +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      x = "normalized rank",
      y = "normalized score",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Cutoff score = ", ifelse(shift,signif(cutOff_FDR, 5),signif(10^(-cutOff_FDR), 5))
      )
    ) +
    ggpubr::labs_pubr() +
    ggpubr::border()
  
  if (plot_cutoff) {
    print(plt)
  }
  
  details <- list(
    cutOff_FDR = cutOff_FDR,
    cutOff_rank = cutOff,
    plot = plt
  )
  
  if (return_details) {
    return(details)
  }
  
  cutOff_FDR
}
```

```{r}
fuzzyorOcc <- function(df, colname="smt_diff_fdr_adj"){
  df %>%
  mutate(fdr = -log10(pmax(.[[colname]], .Machine$double.xmin)))  %>%
  arrange(fdr) %>% filter(!is.na(fdr)) %>%
  mutate(fdr_rank = 1:dplyr::n(),
         fdr_rank = fdr_rank/max(fdr_rank,na.rm = T),
         norm_fdr = fdr/max(fdr,na.rm = T))
}

out_dir <- "final_results_snfl2"
dir.create(out_dir)
```
Calculate occupancy
```{r}
occupancy <- lapply(list(nucs_i0,nucs_i24), function(x){
  res <- fuzzyorOcc(x,colname = "smt_diff_fdr_adj") %>%  get_high_var_nucs( slope_at_cutoff = 1, plot_cutoff = TRUE, return_details = T)
  outTable <- fuzzyorOcc(x,colname = "smt_diff_fdr_adj") %>% 
  mutate(highOccFDR = dplyr::if_else((fdr >= res$cutOff_FDR), TRUE, FALSE)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c("seqnames", "start", "end", "width", "strand", "center",
                  "control_smt_loca", "treat_smt_loca", "control_smt_val",
                  "treat_smt_val", "smt_log2FC", "smt_diff_log10pval", 
                  "smt_diff_FDR", "control_fuzziness_score", "ID", # control_fuzziness_score is included to filter for well positioned nucleosomes
                  "smt_diff_fdr_adj", "fdr","fdr_rank", "norm_fdr", "highOccFDR"))
  
  bed <-   outTable %>% 
    mutate(name = ID, score = smt_diff_fdr_adj) %>% 
  filter(highOccFDR) %>% 
  as_granges()
  
  return(list(cutoff=res, result=outTable, bed=bed))
}) %>% setNames(c("i0","i24"))
```
Calculate fuzziness
```{r}
fuzziness <- lapply(list(nucs_i0,nucs_i24), function(x){
  res <- fuzzyorOcc(x,colname = "fuzziness_diff_fdr_adj") %>%  get_high_var_nucs( slope_at_cutoff = 1, plot_cutoff = TRUE, return_details = T)
  outTable <- fuzzyorOcc(x,colname = "fuzziness_diff_fdr_adj") %>% 
  mutate(highFuzzFDR = dplyr::if_else((fdr >= res$cutOff_FDR), TRUE, FALSE)) %>% 
 dplyr::select(c("seqnames", "start", "end", "width", "strand", "center",
                  "control_fuzziness_score", "treat_fuzziness_score",
                  "fuzziness_log2FC", "fuzziness_diff_log10pval",
                  "fuzziness_diff_FDR", "ID", "fuzziness_diff_fdr_adj", "fdr",
                  "fdr_rank", "norm_fdr", "highFuzzFDR"))
  
  bed <-   outTable %>% 
    mutate(name = ID, score = fuzziness_diff_fdr_adj) %>% 
  filter(highFuzzFDR) %>% 
  as_granges()
  
  return(list(cutoff=res, result=outTable, bed=bed))
}) %>% setNames(c("i0","i24"))
```
calculate shift

```{r}
shift <- lapply(list(nucs_i0,nucs_i24), function(x){
  res <- x %>% filter(!is.na(treat2control_dis_adj)) %>%
    mutate(fdr = (treat2control_dis_adj)) %>% # using nucleosome distance as substitute for significance value
    arrange(fdr) %>% 
    mutate(fdr_rank = 1:dplyr::n(),
           fdr_rank = fdr_rank/max(fdr_rank,na.rm = T),
           norm_fdr = fdr/max(fdr,na.rm = T)) %>%  
    get_high_var_nucs( slope_at_cutoff = 1, plot_cutoff = TRUE, return_details = T, shift = TRUE)
  
  outTable <- x %>% filter(!is.na(treat2control_dis_adj)) %>%
    mutate(fdr = (treat2control_dis_adj)) %>% # using nucleosome distance as substitute for significance value
    arrange(fdr) %>% 
    mutate(fdr_rank = 1:dplyr::n(),
           fdr_rank = fdr_rank/max(fdr_rank,na.rm = T),
           norm_fdr = fdr/max(fdr,na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(highShiftFDR = dplyr::if_else((fdr >= res$cutOff_FDR), TRUE, FALSE)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c("seqnames", "start", "end", "width", "strand", "center",
                  "control_smt_loca", "treat_smt_loca", "treat2control_dis",
                  "treat_smt_loca_smooth", "control_smt_loca_smooth", 
                  "treat2control_dis_adj", "control_fuzziness_score", "ID", # control_fuzziness_score is included to filter for well positioned nucleosomes
                  "fdr","fdr_rank", "norm_fdr", "highShiftFDR"))
  
  bed <-   outTable %>% 
    mutate(name = ID, score = treat2control_dis_adj) %>% 
  filter(highShiftFDR) %>% 
  as_granges()
  
  return(list(cutoff=res, result=outTable, bed=bed))
}) %>% setNames(c("i0","i24"))

```
Saving results

```{r}
rio::export(
  list(
    occupancy = occupancy$i24$result,
    fuzziness = fuzziness$i24$result,
    shift = shift$i24$result
  ),
  file = file.path(out_dir, "i24_results.xlsx")
)

## in article authors used i24 FDR cutoffs on i0 samples because nucleosome occupancy changes are more proound in i24 samples and are more stringent
occupancy$i0$cutoff$cutOff_FDR<occupancy$i24$cutoff$cutOff_FDR
fuzziness$i0$cutoff$cutOff_FDR<fuzziness$i24$cutoff$cutOff_FDR
shift$i0$cutoff$cutOff_FDR<shift$i24$cutoff$cutOff_FDR

rio::export(
  list(
    occupancy = occupancy$i0$result %>% mutate(highOccFDR = if_else((fdr >= occupancy$i24$cutoff$cutOff_FDR ), TRUE, FALSE)),
    fuzziness = fuzziness$i0$result %>% mutate(highFuzzFDR = if_else((fdr >= fuzziness$i24$cutoff$cutOff_FDR ), TRUE, FALSE)),
    shift = shift$i0$result %>% mutate(highShiftFDR = if_else((fdr >= shift$i24$cutoff$cutOff_FDR ), TRUE, FALSE))
  ),
  file = file.path(out_dir, "i0_results.xlsx")
)
```

writing the bed files

```{r}
occupancy$i24$bed %>% write_bed(file = paste0(out_dir,"/i24Occ.bed"))
fuzziness$i24$bed %>% write_bed(file = paste0(out_dir,"/i24Fuzz.bed"))
shift$i24$bed %>% write_bed(file = paste0(out_dir,"/i24Shift.bed"))

occupancy$i0$result %>% mutate(highOccFDR = if_else((fdr >= occupancy$i24$cutoff$cutOff_FDR ), TRUE, FALSE)) %>% 
  mutate(name = ID, score = smt_diff_fdr_adj) %>% filter(highOccFDR) %>% as_granges() %>% write_bed(file = paste0(out_dir,"/i0Occ.bed"))

fuzziness$i0$result %>% mutate(highFuzzFDR = if_else((fdr >= fuzziness$i24$cutoff$cutOff_FDR ), TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
 mutate(name = ID, score = fuzziness_diff_fdr_adj) %>% filter(highFuzzFDR) %>% as_granges() %>% write_bed(file = paste0(out_dir,"/i0Fuzz.bed"))

shift$i0$result %>% mutate(highShiftFDR = if_else((fdr >= shift$i24$cutoff$cutOff_FDR ), TRUE, FALSE)) %>% 
  mutate(name = ID, score = treat2control_dis_adj) %>% filter(highShiftFDR) %>% as_granges() %>% write_bed(file = paste0(out_dir,"/i0Shift.bed"))
```
